description: The Deploy Production workflow fails during the backend image build: node:20-bullseye can no longer apt-install chromium/dependency packages because deb.debian.org has dropped bullseye (deb11) binaries from its security pool while the published index still references them. Two runs of deploy_sha a005aea failed before cutover, so no release can ship until the backend base image or apt sources change.
recommendation: Move apps/backend/Dockerfile base from node:20-bullseye to node:20-bookworm (verified: every apt package in the current list exists in bookworm main/security, and pgdg publishes postgresql-client-17 for bookworm), or pin apt to an EOL archive mirror. Add a preflight check that the backend base image can still resolve its apt packages before a deploy is attempted.
